value.rationale: Two incident shortened edges are the minimal connected perturbation of an equilateral metric beyond the already studied disjoint-pair class. The exact all-dimensional facet count changes on two geometrically meaningful parameter loci, equal edge shortening and triangle equality, with a separate intersection regime. This is an exact structural classification of the dual norm ball, not a few-dimensional table recomputation; the result is useful for metric-cone and polyhedral Lipschitz-free examples.
